messages:
Harrison K.: Quick sync — legal and infra approved the v1->v2 deprecation notice. We need: a short migration summary, updated SDK snippets across JS/Go/Ruby, and link fixes for any examples that still call /v1 endpoints. Tracking PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2733

Meera Iyer: I'll own the migration summary page. Plan: 3 sections: What changed, Quick migration steps, Troubleshooting & FAQ. Keep the Quick steps <5 commands.

Carlos D: I'll update Go and Ruby snippets. For JS I'll show fetch + SDK example. Also include a one-line compatibility tip for Dedicated customers about pinned model aliases.

Meera Iyer: Good call on aliases. Also include a small note about embedding dim changes and reindex command: `./tools/reindex --collection chats`

docs-ci: build passed for branch docs/migrate-v1-v2 (job #1399). Please run smoke tests after redirects land.

l10n-bot: will queue localization jobs when you post `/strings-ready` in the PR. Remember to add translator notes for the embed reindex command.

Carlos D: Draft JS snippet (v2):
```
// JS v2 minimal
await fetch('https://api.redwood.com/v2/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_KEY}` },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwft/gpt-3x', input: 'Summarize this' })
})
```
Collapsed legacy note: `// legacy: set header X-Redwood-Compat: 1`

Meera Iyer: Action items pinned in PR: migration page draft (Meera), snippets (Carlos), redirects + smoke test (Harrison), /strings-ready post after PR green. I'll draft the FAQ bullet on key validity: keys keep working; v1-only behaviors will be retired on schedule.

Harrison K.: ETA: aim to merge banner+migration page by Tue, push snippets by Wed, run smoke tests Thu. I'll announce in #announcements once redirects are scheduled. :thumbsup:
